name: kiri
title: Kiri Focus Timer
description: Run focus blocks from the menu bar, play Kiri background sounds, and save each block to your Kiri history.
author: Project-Kiri

commands.name: start-focus-block
commands.title: Start Focus Block
commands.subtitle: Kiri
commands.description: Pick a length, an optional task and a sound, then start a focus block.

commands.name: kiri-timer
commands.title: Kiri Timer
commands.description: Show the time left in the menu bar, with pause, stop and break controls.

commands.name: start-break
commands.title: Start Break
commands.subtitle: Kiri
commands.description: Start a break with your break length.

commands.name: stop-timer
commands.title: Stop Timer
commands.subtitle: Kiri
commands.description: Stop the running block or break.

commands.name: focus-history
commands.title: Focus History
commands.subtitle: Kiri
commands.description: See the blocks you finished, and connect your Kiri account.

preferences.name: focusMinutes
preferences.title: Default Block Length
preferences.description: The length picked first when you start a focus block.

preferences.name: breakMinutes
preferences.title: Break Length
preferences.description: The length of a break after a focus block.

preferences.name: autoStartBreak
preferences.title: Breaks
preferences.label: Start the break by itself when a block ends
preferences.description: When off, the menu bar offers the break and waits for you.

preferences.name: endSound
preferences.title: End Alert
preferences.label: Play a short sound when a block or break ends

preferences.name: saveToKiri
preferences.title: Kiri History
preferences.label: Save finished blocks to my Kiri account
preferences.description: Only when a Kiri account is connected in Focus History.

preferences.name: pauseOnCall
preferences.title: Calls
preferences.label: Pause a focus block when a call starts
preferences.description: Kiri pauses the block when an app starts using the microphone (FaceTime, Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and others) and waits for you to resume it. Dictation and voice recordings count too. Needs the Kiri Timer menu bar command turned on. Kiri only checks whether the microphone is in use; it never listens.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
